The '''HL-38 armored hovervan''' was an enclosed [[Hovervan/Legends|hovervan]] produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] in the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. This vehicle was 9 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and could carry up to 10 passengers or 600 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo. The HL-38 armored hovervan required a single driver to operate it.
